Title: Create a new order with an urgent delivery date earlier than the order delivery date
Section: Order Management - Urgent Delivery Date Handling
Preconditions: User is logged in as a shop owner and has an item available for order
Steps:
1. Navigate to the 'Create New Order' page. 2. Enter customer details (name, phone, gender). 3. Select an item from the dropdown. 4. Set the order delivery date to a future date (e.g., 10 days from today). 5. In the measurement group section, set an urgent delivery date earlier than the order delivery date (e.g., 5 days from today). 6. Fill in all required fields (making charge, measurements). 7. Click 'Create Order'.

Test Data: Customer Name: John Doe, Phone: 01712345678, Order Delivery Date: 10 days from today, Urgent Delivery Date: 5 days from today, Item: Shirt, Making Charge: 500
Expected Result: 1. The order is created successfully with a confirmation message: 'Order created successfully'. 2. The order details page displays the urgent delivery date (5 days from today) for the measurement group, not the order delivery date.

Title: Update an existing order to set an urgent delivery date earlier than the order delivery date
Section: Order Management - Urgent Delivery Date Handling
Preconditions: User is logged in as a shop owner and has an existing order with at least one measurement group
Steps:
1. Navigate to the 'Orders' page and select an existing order. 2. Click 'Edit Order'. 3. In the measurement group section, set an urgent delivery date earlier than the order delivery date (e.g., 3 days from today). 4. Click 'Update Order'.

Test Data: Order Delivery Date: 10 days from today, Urgent Delivery Date: 3 days from today
Expected Result: 1. The order is updated successfully with a confirmation message: 'Order updated successfully'. 2. The order details page displays the updated urgent delivery date (3 days from today) for the measurement group.

Title: Attempt to set an urgent delivery date later than or equal to the order delivery date and verify error handling
Section: Order Management - Urgent Delivery Date Validation
Preconditions: User is logged in as a shop owner and is creating or updating an order
Steps:
1. Navigate to the 'Create New Order' or 'Edit Order' page. 2. Enter customer details and select an item. 3. Set the order delivery date to a future date (e.g., 10 days from today). 4. In the measurement group section, set an urgent delivery date equal to or later than the order delivery date (e.g., 10 days or 15 days from today). 5. Click 'Create Order' or 'Update Order'.

Test Data: Order Delivery Date: 10 days from today, Urgent Delivery Date: 10 days or 15 days from today
Expected Result: 1. The system displays an error message: 'Urgent delivery date must be earlier than order delivery date'. 2. The order is not created or updated.

Title: Attempt to update an order with an urgent delivery date that is not earlier than the order delivery date
Preconditions: User is logged in as the shop owner or a worker with order update permissions. An existing order with a delivery date of '2025-12-31' is available for editing.
Steps:
1. Navigate to the 'Orders' section in the dashboard. 2. Select the existing order with delivery date '2025-12-31'. 3. Click the 'Edit' button. 4. In the 'Urgent Delivery Date' field, enter '2026-01-01' (a date later than the order delivery date). 5. Click the 'Save' button.

Test Data: Urgent Delivery Date: 2026-01-01 (later than order delivery date 2025-12-31)
Expected Result: The system displays an error message: 'Urgent delivery date must be earlier than order delivery date.' The order is not updated.
